questions.question: Why did the team change its decision about how the new in-app checkout screen is built?
questions.answer_text: It did not change. The team kept build the checkout in the cross-platform framework already used for the settings screens. Concerns raised: Sven objects that checkout is the highest-revenue screen and a janky experience on 22 percent of devices will cost conversions. Elif reports that in a prototype the cross-platform checkout dropped to 38 frames per second while scrolling on a four-year-old Android model that 22 percent of users still have, where the native prototype held 58. Why it stayed: Fatima answers that the drops come from an unoptimised list of 40 saved addresses, that with a virtualised list the same phone reached 55 frames per second in a quick test, and that calling the platform payment sheets through native modules adds only three days to the nine weeks.
